attributeDescription: Character refers to the figure or personality that a particular product refers to.
Brand is the name of the company under which the product is marketed and sold.
Height refers to the measurement from top to base or head to foot of the product.
qualifierDescription: Height refers to the unit used to measure Height. Possible values are cm, inch, mm.

attributeDescription: Brand Colour refers to the shade of the product. Sometimes it can be a name derived from only alphabets or it can be alphanumeric as well. The value 'Multicolour' should be used if the product has 3 or more prominent colours on the product.
Screen Type refers to the type of the screen of the product.

Warranty Service Type refers to the process on the customer's part to claim the warranty. In case of any repair/damage to the product, who/where the customer has to contact and how would the company then process the customer's request (either by sending an engineer or by asking the customer to bring the product at a certain Service Center etc).
Pack of refers to the total number of main products that are included by the brand in the package.
Lights refers to whether the product has a lights while playing or not.
Battery Operated refers to whether the learning toy is Battery operated product or not.
Audio Features refers to the various audio features of the product. Possible values are 20 Sing-a-long Songs, Songs in Spanish and English, etc.

Search Keywords refers to the words which the customer might use to find a product. These keywords are tagged to the product and when the buyer searches with the appropriate search word(s), the nearest appropriate product is retrieved and displayed on Makro website. The search output is also based on multiple other factors such as Product Quality, Pricing, etc. Please enter a maximum of 5 keywords for this purpose.
Model Name is a unique name given to a product by the manufacturer to easily identify or differentiate between products.
exampleValue: LeapFrog My Own Leaptop Learning Toy

attributeDescription: Screen Size refers to the diagonal length of the screen.
Packaging Type specifies the packaging type of the product.
Weight refers to the weight of the product only, without packaging.
qualifierDescription: Weight refers to the unit used to measure Weight. Possible values are g, kg.

attributeDescription: Toy Type refers to the kind of theme/technology on which the toy is based on.
allowedValues: Abacus||Activity Toys||Activity Story Book||Alphabets & Language||Colours & Shapes||Digital Learning||Doodle Boards||Educational Cubes||Educational Toys||Flashcards & Workbooks||History & Geography||Hobbies Crafts Stationery||Kaleidoscope & Projectors||Knob Puzzle||Laptops & Tablets||LCD Writing Pad||Magnetic Drawing Board||Numbers & Maths||Science Project Kit||Shapes Toys||Toy Camera||Write & Wipe

attributeDescription: Please write a few lines describing your product. Description is limited to 5000 characters (including spaces). It should not include any hyperlinks, additional offers, or promotion text.
exampleValue: Foster creativity and learning in children with our engaging learning toys, designed to stimulate curiosity, imagination, and skill development through play.

attributeDescription: Colour refers to the shade of the product as mentioned by the brand on the label or sales package. The value 'Multicolour' should be used if the product has a mix of colours that is 3 or more prominent colours on the product.
Material refers to the substance used to make Learning Toy.

attributeDescription: Battery Type refers to the type of battery used to power a given device.
Other Features refers to any additional information on the features of the product that would be useful to a customer.
Safety Features refers to the various safety features of the product. Possible values are Non-toxic Rubber Body, Non-slip, etc.
exampleValue: Large parts to prevent choking hazards, especially for toddlers and young children||Non-toxic materials used in construction to ensure safety during play

attributeDescription: EAN refers to the 13 digits unique bar code given to each product which is universally recognisable.
Minimum Age refers to the lower age limit for which a product is suitable.
qualifierDescription: Minimum Age refers to the unit used to measure Minimum Age. Possible values are Month, Year.

attributeDescription: Model Number refers to the unique code assigned by the manufacturers to identify the different products that they offer.
Ideal For refers to which gender the product would be most suitable for.
allowedValues: Baby Boys||Baby Boys & Baby Girls||Baby Girls||Boys||Boys and Girls||Girls

attributeDescription: Rechargeable refers to whether or not the product comes with a rechargeable battery.
Depth refers to the distance from the front to the back of the product.
qualifierDescription: Depth refers to the unit used to measure Depth. Possible values are cm, inch, mm.

attributeDescription: Width refers to the breadth, broadness or wideness of a product.
qualifierDescription: Width refers to the unit used to measure Width. Possible values are cm, inch, mm.

attributeDescription: Warranty Summary refers to the overview of the terms and conditions of the warranty coverage for a product. Mostly one-lined information, this should compulsorily have the number of years covered in warranty and the type (domestic or international) of warranty.
exampleValue: 1 Year Domestic Warranty by the Manufacturer.

attributeDescription: Sound refers to whether the product has a sound while playing or not.

Sales Package gives the information of all the contents that are sold in the package. Please specify the package information along with the number of each content mentioned before the name. Data should be double pipe (||) separated.
Skillset refers to the type of skills that the product will help develop in your child.

attributeDescription: Number Of Batteries refers to the batteries' number that you would require to make a device functional.
Certifications refers to a document prepared by a notified body that describes and validates the authenticity and key characteristics of a product.
